description: This file defines a PHP class 'Component' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Vue', which models a Vue.js component with properties such as name and props. It includes getter and setter methods for these properties and a method to add a new property.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents a Vue.js component with a name and properties, allowing manipulation and retrieval of these attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Component instance with a specified name and optional properties.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the component.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the component.

methods.name: getProps
methods.description: Retrieves the array of properties associated with the component.

methods.name: setProps
methods.description: Sets the array of properties for the component.

methods.name: addProp
methods.description: Adds a single Prop object to the component's properties.
